categories.main_business_segments: Beijing Interact Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in intelligent financial services, intelligent security, and intelligent commercial sectors. It provides digital transformation technology services to financial institutions, government departments, and commercial groups, focusing on smart finance, smart security, and smart business solutions. The company also offers IT system solutions and hotel and home media services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages cloud computing, big data, artificial intelligence (AI), blockchain, microservices architecture, distributed systems, multimodal AI, and intelligent agents. It develops proprietary digital banking systems, intelligent security platforms integrating AI algorithms and 5G technology, and smart commercial solutions using large language models and AI-driven marketing. The company emphasizes AI-driven innovation, including generative AI and multi-modal fusion technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major financial institutions such as the Big Four banks, joint-stock banks, rural commercial banks, government and public security departments, and large commercial enterprises across manufacturing, commerce, and fast-moving consumer goods sectors. The company serves industries requiring digital transformation in finance, public safety, and hospitality, including high-end hotels and cable operators.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Beijing with subsidiaries and branches in Shanghai, Guangzhou, Jinan, Chengdu, Taiyuan, Wuhan, Hangzhou, and Hong Kong. Its revenue is primarily generated from the North China and East China regions, with additional operations in Northeast, Northwest, Southwest, Central South, Southeast China, and limited overseas presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Beijing Interact Technology operates primarily as a midstream technology service provider, delivering software development, IT system integration, and digital transformation solutions. It acts as a technology enabler and solution integrator rather than a raw material supplier or end-product distributor.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company strategically focuses on AI technology integration, especially in multi-modal fusion, intelligent agents, and generative AI. It invests heavily in R&D to develop AI-driven digital banking platforms, intelligent security systems, and smart commercial applications. Collaborations with leading domestic technology firms like Huawei and participation in open-source communities underpin its innovation ecosystem. Future R&D emphasizes AI+hardware integration and AI ecosystem construction.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of IT system solutions and digital transformation services, including software development, consulting, and implementation services. The company also earns income from hotel and home media services and rental income from investment properties. It does not rely on subscription or licensing models but on project-based and service-based contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, the company positions itself as a reliable and innovative digital transformation technology service provider with strong AI capabilities. It competes in the software and IT services industry, particularly in financial technology, intelligent security, and smart commercial sectors, leveraging strategic partnerships and proprietary technologies to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 425 million, a 22.27% decrease from the previous year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 3.21 million, showing significant improvement from prior losses. The company has a total asset base of around RMB 758 million and net assets of RMB 447 million. R&D investment increased by 22.9% to RMB 47.29 million, representing 11.13% of revenue, indicating a focus on innovation despite financial challenges.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its full-stack AI-driven technology capabilities, proprietary digital transformation platforms, and deep vertical industry expertise, especially in finance and public security. Its solutions integrate advanced AI, cloud computing, and domestic technology adaptation, offering customers enhanced automation, security, and operational efficiency. Strategic partnerships with leading technology firms and participation in open-source ecosystems further differentiate its offerings.
